note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on every entry). Guides are written for this entry, in our own words, from the official descriptions. The game launched 19 November 2026, so where a place or step is not pinned down by any published source yet, the guide says so plainly instead of inventing it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. Follow this guide's roadmap in order — story first, then side stories, activities, collectibles, heists and cleanup — and keep the four watchlist trophies in mind before the final mission, since those are the only ones whose descriptions suggest a one-time chance.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission. Follow the on-screen objectives with Lucia and Jason — it teaches movement, driving and switching between the two protagonists — and the trophy pops when the mission ends. An unmissable story trophy.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The pause menu's mission list shows what is left; the trophy pops at the chapter's final cutscene. Unmissable if you play the story through.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Same as the other chapter trophies: play the story in order and it pops at the chapter's end. The name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops at the chapter's final cutscene. Nothing to do outside the story for this one — just keep playing the missions in order.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter. The trophy pops at its final cutscene and opens the road to the final mission — the last story step before the gold.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission, which unlocks after Chapter 4. It is the only gold story trophy. Before you start it, make a manual save: the finale is the last point of no return in the story, and a save lets you come back for anything the watchlist flags.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It appears in the mission list during the story; play it through to the end and the trophy pops. Story missions in GTA games are normally replayable, so this one is safe.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is one of the named heist missions in the story; finish it and the trophy pops at the mission-pass screen. Heist missions usually have a setup and a payoff — play both parts through.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Play it through to the end; the trophy pops when the mission passes. Like the other named-mission trophies, it is a story trophy and safe to leave until the mission appears.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish it and the trophy pops at the mission-pass screen. It is one of the named story missions, so it lands in the natural course of the story.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Finish it and the trophy pops. Expect airport security and a getaway — bring a fast car to the mission.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish it and the trophy pops at the mission-pass screen. It is a named story mission, so it lands in the natural course of the story.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. In GTA games that means the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles, the activities and the stunts — every category this guide tracks. Work the checklist to the end and check the in-game completion page in the pause menu (Stats in past GTA games) to see which category is still short. It pops with the last one, and it is the last trophy before the platinum.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near-misses, airtime and drifts — the game counts them as you drive. The fastest farm is long highway runs and the airport runway: jumps off ramps and long drifts stack the counter quickly, and every stunt counts even outside missions. PSN tracks the count to 250.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: 250)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each of the 9 activity types: the ones named across this list are racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation and hunting, plus the ninth type the activities menu shows. One try each is enough — you do not need to win or finish. PSN tracks the count to 9.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: 9)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges are at the gun shops (Ammu-Nation in past GTA games — confirm the in-game map marker). Use the weapon the challenge hands you, aim for headshots on the timed targets, and replay any challenge until the gold time or score lands. PSN tracks the count to 42.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: 42)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at all 14 Top Fun locations. Fly the course once slowly to learn the gates, then race it clean — cutting a gate costs more time than any shortcut saves. One win per location ticks the counter. PSN tracks the count to 14.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: 14)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street, off-road, boat and air races each count as a different event. Enter them from the race markers and the phone, and a win in each new event ticks the counter. Short races are the fastest way to stack wins. PSN tracks the count to 20.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: 20)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing spots are on the coast and piers, and the challenge unlocks after the opening fishing mission. Match the prompt timing on the reel — short, steady pulls beat long ones — and land a bigger catch than Cal.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any arcade machine to completion — arcades are in bars and the mall. Pick the shortest game on your first visit; the trophy pops at the end screen. You do not need a high score, just a finished game.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map after the opening chapters; complete each of Andy's missions in order, and the strand's final mission pops the trophy.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand. Complete each of Kenton's missions in order; the final one pops the trophy. Kenton's strand is boat-based, so expect it on the water around the coast and islands.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand. Complete each of Billy's missions in order; the final one pops the trophy. The name points at a lone-rider, bike-based strand — expect it on two wheels.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish all eight stranger strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus the three more the map reveals as you explore Leonida. The trophy pops on the eighth completed strand. PSN tracks the count to 8.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand. Complete each of Randy's missions in order; the final one pops the trophy. Stranger strands unlock as the story opens up the map, so check the map icons after each chapter.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand. Complete each of Tyrone's missions in order; the final one pops the trophy. Stranger strands unlock as the story opens up the map, so check the map icons after each chapter.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The first spot teaches the mechanic; the rest sit at beaches, parks and viewpoints you pass while exploring. No confirmed map of all 18 exists yet — the game is one day old — so work through them as you explore and check the community map links on this guide's Sources page when they appear. PSN tracks the count to 18.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: 18)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. The hunt strand starts when you meet Bret; track the animal with the hunting scope, follow the trail markers, take the shot cleanly, and bring the trophy back to Bret.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full sets of collectible cards. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, houses and at landmarks — so grab them while doing other activities instead of hunting them all at once. Duplicates may be tradable; a full set pops the counter. PSN tracks the count to 3 sets.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: 3)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It is the in-game photo and tagging activity: tag 100 locations. Each new location the app marks ticks the counter, so work through the map district by district while exploring. PSN tracks the count to 100.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: 100)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's side objectives for driving, combat and exploration. The challenge list is in the pause menu; knock out the easy ones first (distance driven, photos taken, stunts) and the counter climbs to 50 on its own. PSN tracks the count to 50.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: 50)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and hide until it clears. Train tunnels and the swamps lose helicopters fastest; keep moving and do not pick up a new wanted level on the way out.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without the wanted level dropping between them. Plan a route of three close shops, keep each robbery fast, and drive — do not stop — between them. The level must stay up from the first shop to the third.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — every new model you sit in counts. Work through traffic, parking lots and dealerships; the counter is per model, not per car, so a second sedan of the same model adds nothing. PSN tracks the count to 100.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: 100)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode. Trigger it in a firefight with five or more enemies close together and drop all five before the meter runs out. Shotguns and SMGs clear groups fastest; a gang shootout is the easiest place to set it up.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is Vice City International Airport. Steal a plane and take off without a flight plan — or take off from a runway you are not supposed to use. The trophy pops once you are airborne from the airport.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the military tanks. Get one — steal it from the fort or base, or during a story moment that hands you one — and use it. The trophy is tied to the Rhino itself, so drive it and cause chaos until it pops.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in at night and quiet: crouch, stay out of the cameras' cones, take the goods and leave before the alarm. If you are spotted, walk away and try another store — the trophy needs a clean run, not a specific store.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults open during heist setups and free-roam robberies; plan the getaway before you go in — a fast car parked at the back door beats one you have to steal afterwards. PSN tracks the count to 5.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: 5)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, block it, crack it open and escape with the cash. Trucks run set routes through the city — follow one until it stops, then hit it and lose the wanted level.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive every road and visit every named district — the map shades in as you go. The last few are usually the islands and the far north; use a plane or boat for those. PSN tracks the count to 52.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: 52)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations around Leonida. Rob one operation per gang — a gang's turf and operation type are marked once you scout them. One per gang, nine in total, pops the trophy. PSN tracks the count to 9.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: 9)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and drink it with the ocean view. Any beachfront bar works — the trophy pops when the drink animation finishes. It is a good one to grab early, while you are still learning the map.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's front window. Any dealership showroom works — build speed on the street outside and aim for the glass. Expect a wanted level on the way out, so have an escape route ready.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Follow through on your throws — the trophy is about finishing the game, not the score. It also counts toward trying the activity types for Master of None.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with Lucia and Jason — the description reads like a story beat where the pair's notoriety peaks. Watchlist: this looks like a one-time story moment, so do not rush past partner missions, and keep a manual save before story beats that feel like a climax. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in any published guide — treat it as missable until the community confirms otherwise.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Story choices add up — PSN tracks a count to 500. Make choices deliberately through the story, and keep a manual save before big decisions: some choices may not be replayable in the same playthrough. Watchlist: treat it as missable until confirmed, even though the count suggests it accumulates over the whole game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed at something on the second attempt. The description points at a specific retry — most likely a story moment or activity where the first try fails by design. Watchlist: if a mission gives you a scripted failure, keep going — the retry is the trophy. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in any published guide.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a UFO, a cryptid, or another of Leonida's odd events. These events are usually tied to a place and time, and some only happen once. Watchlist: explore the odd corners of the map (the swamps, the far north, the observatory) and do not skip strange encounters. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in any published guide.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops on the hit. Do it on a quiet street to avoid a wanted level.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from heists; launder them through your contacts to turn them into clean cash. $250,000 laundered in total pops the trophy — keep laundering after every heist and it lands on its own. PSN tracks the count to $250,000.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: $250,000)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the game's shops — clothes, weapons, cars and food all count. It accumulates over the whole playthrough; buy gear as you need it and the trophy lands on its own. PSN tracks the count to $100,000.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: $100,000)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties around Leonida. Garages also store your vehicles, so buy the ones near your favorite spots first — and keep enough cash aside, since the last ones are the priciest. PSN tracks the count to 8.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN progress target: 8)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app — the in-game delivery and ride app. Any vehicle you own can be registered; ten registrations pops the trophy. PSN tracks the count to 10.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description, grade)
